Sample CAP files for scripts/test_smn_alerts.py. Real files were downloaded from the public SMN CAP feed (https://ssl.smn.gob.ar/CAP/AR.php, Servicio Meteorológico Nacional, CC BY 2.5 AR) on 2026-11-16. short_SIMULATED_sanalberto_* is a SIMULATED copy of the real Minas short-term warning with the area changed to San Alberto (test only, never issued by SMN). feed.xml is a small hand-made feed with the same item shapes.
